common.auditedNote: Changes are recorded in the audit log with your name, time and IP address.

users.title: Users
users.description: {{count}} accounts — staff and agents. Suspended users are signed out of every session.

actions.suspendLocked: Can't suspend: last active super admin

lastSuperAdmin.hint: This is the only active super admin, so it can't be suspended or lose the super admin role.
lastSuperAdmin.roles: The last active super admin must keep the super admin role.
lastSuperAdmin.notice: There is only one active super admin. To protect access to the platform, that account can't be suspended or lose the super admin role until another super admin is added.

editRoles.title: Edit roles — {{name}}
editRoles.description: A staff member can hold several roles. Permissions are the union of all their roles.
editRoles.atLeastOne: Select at least one role for a staff account.

suspend.title: Suspend {{name}}?
suspend.body: They will be signed out everywhere and won't be able to sign in until reactivated. Their records are kept.

reactivate.title: Reactivate {{name}}?
reactivate.body: They will be able to sign in again with their existing roles and permissions.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: What each staff role can do. The backend enforces every permission; hiding a menu is only a convenience.

descriptions.super_admin: Full platform access, including users, roles, audit logs and system settings.
descriptions.recruiter: Reviews applicants, identity documents and interviews, and decides applications.
descriptions.training_admin: Manages courses, videos, the question bank and quiz configuration.
descriptions.sales_manager: Creates leads, assigns them to qualified agents and follows their progress.
descriptions.property_manager: Maintains the property catalogue: locations, compounds, unit models, media and prices.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.hintEditable: Click a cell to grant or revoke a permission. Super admin always holds every permission.
matrix.hintReadOnly: Read-only view of which permissions each role grants.
matrix.superAdminNote: Super admin is locked: it receives every permission explicitly, and the last active super admin can't be removed.
matrix.confirmBody: {{count}} permission changes will apply to every member of the affected roles at their next request.

permissions.applicants_read: List and view applicants and applications
permissions.identity_review: View ID documents and decide identity reviews
permissions.applications_decide: Accept or reject applications; reopen interviews
permissions.training_manage: Create and edit courses and videos
permissions.quiz_manage: Manage the question bank and quiz configuration
permissions.properties_manage: Manage locations, compounds, types, unit models and media
permissions.leads_read_all: View all leads and assignment history
permissions.roles_manage: Assign roles and edit role permissions

reports.title: Reports
reports.description: Recruitment, training, sales and catalogue figures for the selected period.
reports.scoped: Showing the reports available to the {{role}} role.
reports.exportQueued: Export queued — you'll be notified when the file is ready
reports.footnote: Sample figures for the prototype. Counts are computed from live data in the real platform.

funnel.title: Recruitment funnel
funnel.description: How many applicants reached each step.
funnel.overall: Overall conversion from registration to qualified agent: {{pct}}

qualification.title: Qualification rate
qualification.description: Share of quiz attempts that passed.

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.description: Append-only record of sensitive actions. Personal data is redacted.
audit.appendOnly: Audit entries can't be edited or deleted. Passwords, OTP codes and full national ID numbers are never stored here.

filters.invalidRange: The start date must be on or before the end date.

detail.redactionNote: Values are redacted: sensitive fields are masked and national IDs show only the last 4 digits.

settings.title: System settings
settings.description: Platform-wide limits for OTP, uploads, interviews, identity checks and data retention.
settings.readOnly: You can view these settings, but only a super admin can change them.
settings.fixErrors: Fix the highlighted fields before saving
settings.confirmBody: {{count}} settings will change for every user immediately.

errors.range: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
errors.typesRequired: Enter at least one file type.
errors.typesFormat: Use MIME types separated by commas, for example image/jpeg, video/mp4.
errors.cooldownVsExpiry: The resend cooldown must be shorter than the OTP expiry.

otp.title: Phone verification (OTP)
otp.description: Code lifetime and anti-abuse limits for SMS codes.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.description: Size and type limits checked before and after every upload.

interview.title: Interview
interview.description: Recording limits for the video interview.

identity.title: Identity verification
identity.description: Automatic OCR approval and resubmission rules.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: How long sensitive files are kept after a decision. Pending legal confirmation.

otpExpiryMinutes.label: Code expiry
otpExpiryMinutes.hint: How long a code stays valid.

otpResendCooldownSeconds.label: Resend cooldown
otpResendCooldownSeconds.hint: Wait time before a new code can be requested.

otpMaxWrongAttempts.label: Max wrong attempts
otpMaxWrongAttempts.hint: After this, the code is invalidated.

uploadAllowedTypes.label: Allowed file types
uploadAllowedTypes.hint: MIME types separated by commas. File contents are also checked on the server.

interviewMaxDurationSeconds.label: Max interview duration
interviewMaxDurationSeconds.hint: Recording stops automatically at this length.

identityOcrThresholdPct.label: OCR auto-approve confidence
identityOcrThresholdPct.hint: Below this, the review goes to a recruiter.

identityResubmissionLimit.label: Resubmission limit
identityResubmissionLimit.hint: How many times an applicant can resubmit documents.

retentionIdImagesDays.label: ID images and selfies
retentionIdImagesDays.hint: Days kept after the identity decision.
